ArtifactMetadata.description:
Canonical metadata for an artifact managed by a server-owned store.

`artifact_uri` is the protocol identity (`{scheme}://artifact/{artifact_id}`).
`download_url` is optional bulk-transfer plumbing for large artifacts and
must not become a discovery API.

ArtifactId.description:
Canonical identity of one logical artifact occurrence. Every put creates a
fresh UUIDv7 even when its bytes deduplicate to an existing tenant blob.

ArtifactUri.description: Neutral or server-presented Artifact occurrence URI.

ComplianceMetadata.description:
Compliance and tenancy labels that travel with server-owned artifacts.

Object metadata is not the only authorization source; servers should keep
owner rows for task/artifact access checks. These typed fields keep exported
artifact metadata aligned with the gateway principal and policy model.

DataLabelId.description: Policy data label such as `cui`, `itar`, `pii`, or an IdP-provided clearance label.

TenantId.description: Tenant, organization, or customer boundary identifier.

AccessSubject.description: A principal or group that can own governed data or receive access.

PrincipalId.description: Stable authenticated user or service-principal identity.

GroupId.description: Identity-provider group identifier used by gateway policy.

WorkContextId.description: Tenant-local boundary that governs related work and every output it produces.

ArtifactProvenance.description: Immutable explanation of how an artifact came into being.

PolicyVersion.description: Immutable policy version identifier emitted with decisions and audit records.

DelegationId.description: Auditable identity of authority delegated by an initiator to another actor.
